basic_details.job_title: GIPMER Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 11 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Govind Ballabh Pant Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education & Research (GIPMER), New Delhi, Delhi, has invited applications for 11 posts of Senior Resident under Advt No. F.56/GIPMER/Estt/SR/Interview/2025. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Cash or Demand Draft issued by a nationalized bank in favour of Medical Superintendent, G.B. Pant Hospital, payable at New Delhi; cash may be deposited with the Cashier at the Accounts branch, GIPMER.

qualification.education_qualification: MBBS with P.G Degree or Diploma in the concerned specialty from a Recognized University/Institution and registration with the Delhi Medical Council (candidates who have applied for DMC registration may also apply).
qualification.details: Qualification: MBBS with P.G Degree or Diploma in the concerned specialty from a Recognized University/Institution; Registration with the Delhi Medical Council; candidates who have applied for DMC registration may also apply Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on interview date) Age relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years | Other conditions: | Registration with the Delhi Medical Council; candidates who have applied for DMC registration may also apply Selected candidates may have to join within 03 days of issue of offer letter/Memorandum

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs 67,700 plus usual allowances as admissible under the rules

how_to_apply: Get the application form (Annexure-I) from the Institute's website gbpant.delhigovt.nic.in.
Paste a latest self-attested passport size photograph and enclose proof of date of birth, attested copies of certificates and SC/ST/OBC certificate if applicable.
Pay Rs. 300/- by Demand Draft in favour of Medical Superintendent, G.B. Pant Hospital, payable at New Delhi, or in cash at the Accounts branch cashier.
Write your name on the reverse side of the demand draft/TR V.
Submit the application at D-Block, 5th Floor, Academic Cell, GIPMER on/before 30.11.2026 up to 04.00 P.M.
Report at 12:00 Noon on 02.12.2026 in the Anaesthesia Department for the 01.00 PM interview.
important_instructions: Number of posts is indicative and may vary depending on vacancies at the time of interview If the interview day is a holiday, the interview will be held on the next working day If the interview cannot be completed on the scheduled date, it will continue on the following working day No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview No correspondence or personal enquiries shall be entertained Jurisdiction for any legal dispute is Delhi/New Delhi only

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBBS with P.G Degree or Diploma in the concerned specialty from a Recognized University/Institution; Registration with the Delhi Medical Council; candidates who have applied for DMC registration may also apply Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on interview date) Age relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years Other conditions: Registration with the Delhi Medical Council; candidates who have applied for DMC registration may also apply Selected candidates may have to join within 03 days of issue of offer letter/Memorandum

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely adhoc basis for 44 days or as per further instructions/orders of H&FW Department, GNCTD, or till regular incumbents join, whichever is earlier Appointment and services governed under the Residency Scheme Appointment subject to medical fitness and verification of certificates DMC certificate with P.G qualification to be produced before joining; DMC applicants may join provisionally on production of DMC fee receipt

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Cash or Demand Draft issued by a nationalized bank in favour of Medical Superintendent, G.B. Pant Hospital, payable at New Delhi; cash may be deposited with the Cashier at the Accounts branch, GIPMER.

Write your name on the reverse side of the demand draft/TR V. Submit the application at D-Block, 5th Floor, Academic Cell, GIPMER on/before 30.11.2026 up to 04.00 P.M. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 11 vacancies for Senior Resident.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I of this notice; also on the Institute's website gbpant.delhigovt.nic.in) and send it to D-Block, 5th Floor, Academic Cell, GIPMER, by by hand, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates: Rs. 300 (Non Refundable).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (as on interview date). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs 67,700 plus usual allowances as admissible under the rules.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS with P.G Degree or Diploma in the concerned specialty from a Recognized University/Institution and registration with the Delhi Medical Council (candidates who have applied for DMC registration may also apply).

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Registration with the Delhi Medical Council; candidates who have applied for DMC registration may also apply. Selected candidates may have to join within 03 days of issue of offer letter/Memorandum.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. A panel of wait listed candidates will be prepared separately.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely adhoc basis for 44 days or as per further instructions/orders of H&FW Department, GNCTD, or till regular incumbents join, whichever is earlier. Appointment and services governed under the Residency Scheme. Appointment subject to medical fitness and verification of certificates.
